flags.question: Identify the top 3 characters based on the sum of their centrality values across all books.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (c:Character)
WITH c, 
     c.centrality + c.book1BetweennessCentrality + c.book1PageRank + c.book45PageRank AS totalCentrality
RETURN c.name AS characterName, totalCentrality
ORDER BY totalCentrality DESC
LIMIT 3
details: Question asks for total/sum but TypeQL has no sum()

flags.question: Name the top 3 characters based on the sum of their book1PageRank and book45PageRank.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (c:Character)
WITH c, (c.book1PageRank + c.book45PageRank) AS totalPageRank
RETURN c.name AS characterName, totalPageRank
ORDER BY totalPageRank DESC
LIMIT 3
details: Question asks for total/sum but TypeQL has no sum()

flags.question: Which characters have the highest sum of pagerank values across all books? Limit to top 5.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (c:Character)
WITH c, 
     c.book1PageRank + c.book45PageRank + c.pagerank AS totalPageRank
ORDER BY totalPageRank DESC
LIMIT 5
RETURN c.name AS characterName, totalPageRank

flags.question: List the characters who have a centrality value of exactly 0.8. Limit to top 5.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (c:Character)
WHERE c.centrality = 0.8
RETURN c.name
LIMIT 5
